backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing confessions, threads, events, resources, moderation actions, user profiles, and access control with various ID counters and data maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI refresh and branding tasks to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing short summaries of numerous frontend components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining OKLCH gradients, themes, and component variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point linking the generated app icon and bootstrapping the React app.
Documentation explaining how to use generated app icon and splash screen assets when packaging Android and iOS web‑view wrappers.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration defining all app routes, layout structure, and onboarding flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI component showing an access-denied message with a return-home button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Gate component that requires an authenticated admin, showing login, loading, or access-denied states before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/confessions/Conf: Displays a confession with timestamp and a report button that opens a report dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with tabs and highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/layout/MobileSca: Mobile layout wrapper providing header, scrolling content area, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/moderation/Repor: Modal for submitting a report with reason and optional note, using a mutation to send data.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Quick: Multi-step onboarding tour with icons, descriptions, and navigation controls to mark completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useComplianceGate.ts: Manages a localStorage flag for compliance acceptance with helpers to accept or reset.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for Internet Identity login, identity management, and AuthClient initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for confessions, profiles, admin checks, reporting, and moderation actions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuickTour.ts: Provides state and helpers for tracking quick‑tour completion using localStorage.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes, including gradients and component utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/chat/EncryptedChatEnt: Stub page for an encrypted chat, showing match info and placeholder messaging UI.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/Confessio: Displays approved confessions with loading and error states and a button to submit new ones.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/NewConfes: Form to submit a new confession with validation, moderator notice, and navigation back to the feed.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/Discussio: Lists discussion categories and shows an empty-state UI with navigation to create a new discussion.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/NewThread: Form for creating a new discussion thread with title, category, and content, followed by a placeholder submit action.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/ThreadDet: Placeholder thread detail page with back navigation.
frontend/src/pages/events/EventDetail.ts: Placeholder event detail page with back navigation.
frontend/src/pages/events/Events.tsx: Displays event filters and an empty-state list; admins can create new events.
frontend/src/pages/events/NewEvent.tsx: Admin-only form for creating a new event with type, location, and description.
frontend/src/pages/HelpSupport.tsx: Renders help resources, crisis info, and community guidelines using cards and accordions.
frontend/src/pages/matches/Matches.tsx: Shows user matches with login handling, loading states, and navigation to swipe matching.
frontend/src/pages/matches/SwipeMatching: Implements swipe-based matching flow with candidate fetching, swipe actions, and authentication gating.
frontend/src/pages/moderation/ModeratorD: Admin dashboard for reviewing reported confessions and updating moderation status.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingGate.tsx: Gate screen requiring age and guideline confirmations before granting access via the compliance gate.
frontend/src/pages/profile/Profile.tsx: Profile page that loads, edits, and saves a user's private profile with authentication checks and conditional UI states.
frontend/src/pages/resources/Resources.t: Resources page providing searchable, category-filtered mental health support links.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing profile privacy toggles and quick‑tour reset, with save operations via API hooks.
frontend/src/utils/privacy.ts: Utility functions for anonymous labels, timestamp formatting, and principal redaction.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending themes, colors, fonts, shadows, and animations for the project.
project_state.json: Project state description including current features, architecture notes, issues, and mobile build requirements.
